points.description: Gives a first valid limitation of AJM (abrasive jet machining), matching the model answer: low material removal rate (slow machining), limited/short nozzle life (nozzle wear), or high cost. Clear synonyms accepted (e.g. 'slow process', 'nozzle wears out quickly', 'expensive').
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the idea is vague or slightly wrong (e.g. 'nozzle problem' without wear or life; 'not efficient' without saying slow).

points.description: Gives a second, different valid limitation of AJM from the model answer (low MRR, limited nozzle life, or high cost), in any clear wording.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the idea is vague or slightly wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for any two different limitations from the model answer: low MRR, limited nozzle life, high cost, with synonyms accepted. Give 1 mark if only one is correct, or if both are given but vaguely. A wrong or unrelated limitation earns nothing for that point and does not affect the other. Two wordings of the same limitation count once.
